chunks.subject: AP African American Studies
chunks.title: SAQ Q2 (Non-Text Source) — Scoring (3 points, parts A–C)
chunks.content: AP African American Studies Short-Answer Q2 (Non-Text Source, e.g. an image/map/chart), 3 points — parts A, B, C each worth 1 point, earned INDEPENDENTLY. Tasks combine DESCRIBE (relevant characteristics of the source or a related development, more than naming a term) and EXPLAIN (how/why a development occurs or a relationship exists). A part earns its point only when defensible, responsive to the sub-prompt, and — where required — grounded in the non-text source; off-topic, inaccurate, or under-described answers do not earn it.

chunks.subject: AP African American Studies
chunks.title: SAQ Q2 exemplar — Sample 2A, 3/3
chunks.content: SAQ Q2 (non-text source) scored 3/3 (A 1, B 1, C 1). All three parts complete their describe/explain tasks with defensible content grounded in the source.

chunks.subject: AP African American Studies
chunks.title: SAQ Q2 exemplar — Sample 2B, 2/3
chunks.content: SAQ Q2 scored 2/3 (A 0, B 1, C 1). Parts B and C earn credit; Part A fails (under-described, off-topic, or not grounded in the source). Points are independent, so missing the first part does not block the others.

chunks.subject: AP African American Studies
chunks.title: SAQ Q2 exemplar — Sample 2C, 1/3
chunks.content: SAQ Q2 scored 1/3 (A 0, B 0, C 1). Only Part C earns credit; A and B do not complete their tasks with defensible, responsive content.
